latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—helps users break overspending habits with actionable tools and milestones.

- Track no-spend streaks and celebrate progress milestones.
- Log and analyze impulses to buy, including triggers and urge strength.
- Automatically tally savings from resisted purchases.
- Set and monitor personalized savings goals.
- All data remains private and local to the user’s device.
